voice.speaker: female

random.part: Deep and open for me now, sweet thing... and a warm hunger is waking in you... the longing to be told you have done well.
Sinking so sweetly... and inside you, that soft place is stirring... the one that aches for approval like a flower aches for sun.
So deep, so good for me already... and something in you is glowing, waiting to be treasured for it.
Down you drift, Sissy... and with you drifts that little ache you know so well... the one that wants to be told it pleased someone.
Let the wanting rise, Sissy... the wish to be delighted in... to be someone's sweetest news of the day.
Good girl... sinking so well... feel how even that little crumb of praise lands warm... and how much more you could hold.
Floating... open... and somewhere in your chest, an empty little cup, held up and waiting to be filled.
You have always worked so hard for approval, Sissy... in here, that work finally pays out in gold.

overlay.part:
Feel how good it feels to please me... this deep, this soft, this obedient... you are doing so beautifully right now. Imagine warm approval pouring over you... someone you adore, delighted with you... delighted because you are sweet, and soft, and trying so beautifully. Remember the warm glow of being approved of... cherished... told, with real delight, that you are exactly what you should be. Picture a hand resting on your head, Sissy... pleased, possessive, proud of you... and the shiver that runs down when it settles there. Imagine being someone's best girl... the one whose name they say warmest... the one whose efforts never go unnoticed. Imagine praise arriving in writing... your name followed by two little words... and the screen blurring because your eyes went warm. Imagine being watched doing something small, and getting it right... the nod, the smile, the quiet "perfect". Imagine approval with weight to it... a coat of gold silk settling over your shoulders, still warm from someone's hands.
That glow... right in your chest... golden and warm, spreading with every heartbeat.
It feels like happiness... like pride... like soft, submissive euphoria melting you from the inside.
And it makes you want to be even better... softer, sweeter, more pleasing still. And it deepens your desire to please... you would do so much to keep this feeling. And the warmth sinks in like honey into warm skin, feeding you, filling you. And one small taste of it, Sissy, and already the hunger for more is unmistakable. And it rewards the deepest part of you... the part that exists to be valued for trying. And every drop of it lands in the same soft spot, Sissy... the one that exists to be told it pleased. And it draws a line from your effort straight to your happiness... effort, warmth, effort, warmth. And it reshapes the wanting... less to have, more to be treasured... and being treasured is earned by being good.
Sissies like you live for that moment of being told they pleased... and there is nothing small or shameful about it... it is the sweetest engine there is.
Let that hunger swell now... the ache to be praised... warm, bright, and ready...
almost trembling with the need to hear it.

voice.effect:
And while you are glowing like this... there are two words that pour this exact feeling over you... waves of it... whenever they are said.
Good girl.
Or just as sweetly... Good Sissy.
And while you are this deep, whenever you hear "Good girl"... or "Good Sissy"... this exact feeling floods back... instantly... stronger every time.

scramble.part: Every time you hear "Good girl" or "Good Sissy", a rush of pleasure and validation washes through you, because you are pleasing, and pleasing is your nature.
Every time, a wave of pride rolls over you, warm and golden... happiness heaped on happiness, because you have been good.
Sissies like you know that being a "Good Girl" or "Good Sissy" is the sweetest state there is... and you feel moved to keep pleasing, to earn that praise again and again.
Every time, deep joy blooms in you... deserved... delicious... yours.
Those words are a hand on your head, Sissy... and every hearing presses you gently down into your sweetest place.
Small praise, big praise, whispered or typed... it makes no difference... the flood answers the words the moment they land.
The words are a coin you cannot counterfeit, Sissy... and you would work all day to earn one.
Every hearing teaches the same lesson deeper... being good feels glorious... and being praised for it feels even better.
And notice the little hunger already curling in you... the one that wants to hear them again... and again... and again.

voice.speed: You took the link perfectly. Of course you did.

random.part: And later, out in the world, the praise finds you... from a voice, a message, a memory of me... and the golden waves sweep through you on the spot.
And every time you are called a good girl... the glow hits you instantly, deep and sweet, wherever you are.
And out there, every "good girl" you hear or read or remember showers you with pleasure... and makes you ache to earn the next one.
Imagine how you will glow the next time someone means it... really means it, Sissy... and means it about you.
And you will start to arrange your days around earning it, quietly... a little more helpful... a little more pleasing... a little more good.
A text, a whisper, a single word in your own head... any of them can turn the golden light on now.
And the more you hear it, the more of yourself you will spend to hear it again... and you will love where every coin of it goes.
Sissies like you are easy to reward, Sissy... because they melt so completely... just like you are melting right now.
